scope: Reviewed source arithmetic projection; K divisible by 16; identity epilogue
limitations: Reviewed manual C++ arithmetic projection; no verified C++ frontend
No memory, lane/register transport, compiler, PTX/SASS, or physical GPU proof
Numerical WMMA primitive uses the selected finite-domain V100 paper model
Nonfinite or out-of-range arithmetic is rejected by Lean; hardware exceptions are outside the connection
Partial K is excluded: the pinned input iterator handles the residue first
CUDA compilation and execution require separate validation on a CUDA/V100 system
